items.summary: Recommendation: finish and measure the existing reversible work, while retrying the already-approved evidence work for 0xroulette.com and completing parked-domain triage for complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com; do not create duplicate site tasks. The 30-day SEO window recorded 13,177 impressions, 126 clicks, 932 sessions, and 13 conversions; Amazon reported $4.92 commission on 2026-09-21 from 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items. Site-level margin and ROI are not calculable because one tracking ID remains unmapped and direct costs are unavailable. The main unknown is which sites can produce attributable contribution margin without disproportionate build or renewal cost. Smallest next step: complete the three bounded evidence workstreams, preserve rollback notes, and measure deployed changes after 14 days or 100 new impressions. Owner question: for SearchWoot choose A) prepare an unsent Woot permission request, B) keep private with no outreach, or C) end the public-beta pursuit.
